mapper.select: /*auth.findLoginInfo */ SELECT a.id as accountId, a.password_hash, a.auth_role, b.employee_code, b.employee_name, b.employee_role, d.department_code, c.team_code, e.position_code FROM auth.account a JOIN employee.profile b ON a.id = b.id JOIN employee.team c ON b.team_id = c.id JOIN employee.department d ON c.department_id = d.id JOIN employee.position e on b.position_id = e.id WHERE a.user_name = #{userName}

/*auth.findRefreshInfo */ SELECT a.id as accountId, a.password_hash, a.auth_role, b.employee_code, b.employee_name, b.employee_role, d.department_code, c.team_code, e.position_code FROM auth.account a JOIN employee.profile b ON a.id = b.id JOIN employee.team c ON b.team_id = c.id JOIN employee.department d ON c.department_id = d.id JOIN employee.position e on b.position_id = e.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId}
